correctness.rationale: The explicit rational Schwarz map factors as a zero times disk automorphism composition, so it maps D into D. The target polynomial has positive real part on the unit circle by (2/9)(3(1+x)^2−2x^3)>0, and hence within D. The integral-defined odd part u is starlike and the function f satisfies Re(zf′/u)>0, so classical close-to-convex univalence applies. The exact source class identity follows algebraically. An independently executed stdlib Fraction verifier recalculates all rational Taylor coefficients and H3,1=−173595619/2754990144, with strict positive gaps over 769/12288 and 1/16; no finite test is substituted for the infinite-domain univalence proof.

value.rationale: The counterexample directly resolves the validity of two specifically published/proposed inequalities for the same natural coefficient invariant on the same named class. It supplies an exact rigorous boundary with an easy-to-reproduce finite Blaschke parameter and separates proven older bounds from the false narrower claims. It is not a routine specialization, numerical sampling artifact, or unmotivated arbitrary slice, despite not determining the true supremum.
